ai_assessment.method: Full direct English-to-Vietnamese comparison of all 4055 canonical passages and both titles. Separate subagent drafting from the original preceded review. A separate-context assessor (same model family, not shown the drafter’s notes or scores) read every pair first and reported about thirty major and about ninety minor findings with a pre-revision weighted score of 7.7; the drafter revised the text, re-read the changed passages and the whole target for naturalness, then assigned these final scores bound to the final byte hashes.
ai_assessment.limitations: The same AI system drafted, revised and assessed the work; the separate-context pass is correlated same-model feedback, not independent review or model diversity. No human literary reviewer, native-reader trial or measured reader demand is claimed. Existing Vietnamese translations were not consulted or collated. Scores are subjective and uncalibrated; missed errors may remain. Source clearance is separately recorded and is not granted by this review.

summary: All 4055 units of the complete novel as printed by Project Gutenberg #1260, translated directly from the English. The first blind reviews of the four slices scored 8.1, 7.7, 7.7 and 8.53 with about thirty major findings, mostly referents, speakers, address forms, bird and object names and sense reversals. Each slice was then revised in fix rounds, and separate-context blind reviews re-checked the revisions and found further majors, each fixed; the final confirmation reviews score slice 1 at 8.75 (first half) and 8.80 (second half), slice 2 at 8.93, slice 3 at 8.75 and slice 4 at 8.80, with no critical or major finding open. The weakest part, 8.75, sets the score. Minor findings are recorded in the review files and do not block release.

title_review.rationale: The title is the work’s own, ‘Jane Eyre’; the Vietnamese edition keeps the English name.
